summary: Backend (11 pytest tests) all PASS covering /api/regions listing + story graph for bali/aceh, /api/progress explore/complete flow with non-duplicate collectibles, explorer level thresholds (0/2/4/6/8 -> Musafir Baru/Penjelajah/Penjelajah Ahli/Penjaga Cerita/Duta Nusantara), /api/voice submit -> pending (not on wall), /api/voice/wall seeded entries. Frontend core loop verified end-to-end via Playwright: Home hero + progress + 8 region cards + 8 map pins, click Bali -> scenes -> choice-c1 -> discovery -> collectible reveal modal. Passport shows stamp, collectible card, story-found row, milestone-2 reached, and Explorer Card unlocked with functional share/download buttons (download produced PNG). Suara: fresh session shows voice-locked, after 1 completion form appears + wall shows 5 seeded entries + submission returns pending notice. Session persists across page refresh via localStorage.

ui_bugs.issue: Original code accessed r.story.title / r.story.category on region SUMMARY objects (which only expose storyTitle/category). This caused runtime crash: 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading title)' whenever any story was completed, breaking the entire Passport page.

action_items: Review the Passport.js fix I applied: replaced r.story.title -> r.storyTitle and r.story.category -> r.category so it aligns with the region_summary payload from /api/regions. Consider adding storyCategory explicitly to region_summary if you prefer to keep category distinct from region category.

Minor: content.py defines an extra EXPLORER_LEVELS entry (min=1 'Penjelajah Muda') that is not part of the documented 0/2/4/6/8 milestone spec. At completedCount=1 the level shown is 'Penjelajah Muda'. If not intended, remove that entry.
critical_code_review_comments: Passport.js: use only fields exposed by /api/regions summary (slug,name,island,category,accent,tagline,blurb,image,map,storyTitle,collectible). Was accessing r.story.* — undefined at runtime.
server.py compute_level: OK. But EXPLORER_LEVELS in content.py contains a min=1 entry not covered by the spec.
AppContext.recordProgress: fine; consider adding error handling for network failures.
CORS_ORIGINS='*' with allow_credentials=True is technically invalid per CORS spec — browsers ignore credentials with wildcard. Not blocking (no cookies used) but flag for prod.
Voice submission uses Pydantic min_length=1 -> returns 422; front-end disables submit on empty, so acceptable.
test_credentials: None — anonymous session via localStorage key jelajah_nusa_session
seed_data_creation: Progress rows created with TEST_ prefixed session_ids; one pending voice entry inserted with marker TEST_HARAPAN_pw (pending, not shown on wall).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests are in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (pytest). Public URL is REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env. All frontend flows use data-testids consistently. If retesting, clear localStorage before fresh-session assertions.
rca of the issue: Passport.js 'Cerita ditemukan' block iterated regions matched by slug from progress.stories and rendered r.story.title. However /api/regions/list returns a SUMMARY (region_summary) — the full nested `story` object is only returned by /api/regions/{slug}. So the frontend's regions state never contained r.story, leading to a TypeError. Fix applied: use r.storyTitle (already in summary) and r.category. Steps to reproduce (pre-fix): 1) Fresh session 2) Complete any region story 3) Navigate to /passport -> whole page fails to render (React error boundary triggers).
